Confirmed the pinned closing block (26041703) timestamp via the operator's keyed RPC (http://127.0.0.1:8546/1) is 1790184971 (2026-09-23T17:36:11Z), essentially the current time, so this live OpenSea read is the closest available reading to the pinned block per the 'time' definition. No per-listing breakdown was needed since the endpoint reports the aggregate floor directly; all active CryptoPunks listings on OpenSea are denominated in ETH/WETH so no non-ETH listings needed to be excluded.

definitions.time: Read at the time of this run, whose wall-clock time is within seconds of the pinned closing block's timestamp (block 26041703 timestamp 1790184971, i.e. 2026-09-23T17:36:11Z), since OpenSea's stats endpoint reflects live listings only and has no historical query.
definitions.floor: OpenSea's reported collection floor_price (total.floor_price) from GET /api/v2/collections/cryptopunks/stats, denominated in ETH, converted to wei at 1 ETH = 1000000000000000000 wei.
definitions.collection: The official CryptoPunks collection on OpenSea, slug "cryptopunks" (contract 0xb47e3cd837ddf8e4c57f05d70ab865de6e193bbb), the verified collection with by far the largest market cap for this name.

definitions.time: Read live from OpenSea stats API at run time; historical value at the closing block was not retrievable.
definitions.floor: Lowest active OpenSea listing for the verified CryptoPunks collection, in ETH, converted to wei (1 ETH = 1e18 wei).
